_why: The graph lane is on by default at a weight that is not zero, and graph_learn.py moves it within 0.05..0.4 from recall's own log. 0.1 is the measured starting point: on a held-out bank of 968 reworded questions the link walk at 0.1 gave hit@5 0.348 against bm25's 0.344, the use walk 0.342 (within noise). With no use-grown store (store empty) only the walk over the memories' own links runs. ppr_iters 8 instead of 20 gave the same top 8 on 50 of 50 questions at a third of the time. 0 turns the lane off; BRAIN_GRAPH_LAMBDA overrides; BRAIN_GRAPH_STORE names a store.
